decisions.reason: The existing message-539 MODIFY already fully captures the necessary impact by restarting the replacement-contract token sequence and excluding legacy-contract NFTs and their referral codes from the active referral system.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits referral, ticket, and payout reporting to the active replacement contract and excludes legacy-contract reward data.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already applies the accepted legacy-NFT exclusion by restricting random no-referral commission recipients to owners of NFTs from the active replacement contract.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already records that Transak-originated mints target the active replacement contract only; no additional attributes became obsolete.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already restricts the ETH wallet mint flow to the active replacement contract, fully representing the source decision's impact.
